title: Plan Reviewer result tool contract
description: v2.22 §2.B4 — input_schema for the report_plan_reviewer tool forced via tool_choice. Mirrors references/plan-reviewer-prompt.md Output Format: a single issues[] array with a per-issue severity field (BLOCKER | WARN).

status.description: PASS when every rubric item passes; ISSUES_FOUND otherwise.

severity.description: BLOCKER would cause a SPEC_BLOCKER escalation; WARN is friction only.

task.description: task_<id> the issue belongs to, or null for plan-wide issues.

category.description: e.g. missing_ac | contract_mismatch | naming_drift | dep_inconsistency | missing_files | out_of_repo | resource_key_collision | spec_manifest_invalid_ref | spec_manifest_fallback_used | spec_manifest_unused_section.

suggested_fix.description: One sentence — smallest edit that resolves it.
